description_sq:
Apartament ne shitje 1+1, me vendodhje prane Casa Italia,te Pallatet e verdha Terminali.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe prej 117 m2 ne te cilat 56.7 m2 eshte veranda.
Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje dhe ambient gatimi nje dhome gjumi me dalje ne ballkon,nje tualet si dhe nje verande e madhe.
Ndodhet ne katin e 3-te, te nje pallati te ri me ashensor.
Shitet totalisht i mobiluar.
Disponon Certifikate Pronesie!
description_en: Apartment for sale 1+1, located near Casa Italia, in Palatet e verdha Terminali. The apartment has an area of ​​117 m2, of which 56.7 m2 is the veranda. It is organized in a living room and kitchen area, a bedroom with access to the balcony, a toilet and a large veranda. It is located on the 3rd floor of a new building with an elevator. For sale fully furnished. Has Ownership Certificates!
